page: Microsoft Azure E96ps_v7 is an arm64-based memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 96 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. It contains no hardware accelerators or GPUs, concentrating system capacity entirely on general processing and memory density.

The E96ps_v7 instance does not include integrated local disk storage, operating without bundled ephemeral drives. Storage requirements are met through external network-attached volumes, with compatibility for Azure Premium Storage. The configuration includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires explicit assignment of networking resources for direct public access.

Targeting arm64 execution environments, the high memory-to-vCPU allocation supports high-density transactional systems and scalable memory footprints. The primary operational fit includes large in-memory caching solutions, enterprise database management systems, data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive enterprise applications optimized for ARM architecture.
